tools.name: apply_patch
tools.description: Apply a unified patch to files in the workspace.

format.definition:
start: patch
patch: "*** Begin Patch\n" /.+/s "*** End Patch\n"

content.text: Update timeout from 5 to 15 in config.toml and README.md.

input.name: apply_patch
input.input:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: config.toml
@@
-timeout = 5
+timeout = 15
*** End Patch

input.output:
Success. Updated the following files:
M config.toml
